Green Day

We will run the advisory schedule today. A reminder to all Juniors and Seniors to report to Fuller Hall during advisory for ALICE training. 9th and 10th graders should report to their advisory locations.
Tomorrow we will have our first Pep Chapel of the year! All students and advisors should report directly to the Alumni Gym by 7:55am. Get ready to get that Topper beat!
Seniors: rise, shine, and get your glow on tomorrow morning at Senior Sunrise at 5:30am! Kick off senior year with the best view and the best crew. Check your email for more details.
Reminder — the 2027 India trip has a meeting in Tinker house after school.

Academy theater is holding a Tech crew meeting for this falls production of “She Kills Monsters” today @ 4pm in the stage craft shop in Morse. So, if you’re interested in building sets, making props, and designing puppets, come to the stage craft room in Morse today at 4pm to find out more. Please email Mr. Kane with any questions.

The Zen Zone meets after school today — and every Thursday — in NH 10 starting at 3:30. Come find your inner calm! This club is open to everyone. Come if you want to relax and learn how to clear your mind of clutter. See Ms. Greenstone with questions.
Chess Club meets today at 3:15 in Streeter 225. Master to novice, all are welcome! That’s chess club, every Thursday at 3:15 in Streeter 225. Any questions, see Mr. Buhner, also in Streeter 225.

In support of our first responders, our home opener football game on Friday night will be themed red, white, and blue! Dress your best to appreciate our emergency service providers and support our football team.
Now it’s time for Michael’s Joke of the Week: What do you call a boomerang that never comes back?…A stick 😊

Green Day

Tomorrow we will follow the Walk for a Healthy Community Schedule. Students should report directly to their A block class by 7:55am, as there will be no Chapel. We will follow the ABDEC schedule, followed by advisory meetings before the walk.

Good morning, Class of 2028! Please check your school email this morning—a new ballot will be sent at 8:30 AM. A runoff vote is required to determine your Class President, so please take a moment today to cast your final vote and make your voice heard! The ballot will close at 3:30 PM.

The Mid-Autumn Festival is a traditional East Asian holiday celebrated on the 15th day of the 8th month of the lunar calendar. The full moon is an important symbol of the festival because its round, complete shape represents wholeness, reunion, and togetherness. Mooncakes are traditionally shared with family and friends as a symbol of reunion and togetherness, making them a special part of the celebration. Students who celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival are invited to join us for a mooncake-making gathering on Friday, September 25th at 3:30 PM in the South Church Kitchen. Questions? Please see Ms. Davis in Streeter 255.

Fellowship of Christian Athletes (FCA) is starting this Friday! FCA is a student group focused on faith, sports, and their impacts on our lives. Our conversations will be rooted in the Christian faith, but you don’t have to be a Christian or an athlete to come. We’ll meet Friday mornings from 7:00–7:40 on Court 3 in the Field House. FCA is student-led, and we’re looking for students who want to help lead and shape this group. Come check it out this Friday!

Who doesn’t love a good food truck? Join us for SJA After Dark on Saturday, September 26th, from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM at Fairbanks Field under the lights! Join us for an awesome night featuring live music, games on the turf, and plenty of time to hang out with friends.

There is still time to sign up for this weekend’s rock-climbing trip! Don’t miss out on this once in a lifetime opportunity and come climb up some rock walls with the Outing Club. See Mr. Larsen in Student Life, or Mr. Holden in the Field House for details. Dare to explore.

Tomorrow is SJA’s “Walk for a Healthy Community”. Our goal is to have the biggest showing of Topper pride that we can as we walk. To that end, we invite you to pair a green, white, green and white, or your SJA gear top tomorrow with any dress standard bottoms. We understand you may have class specific SJA sweatshirts that are otherwise out of dress standard — Friday is a really special opportunity to wear that or any other green/white/green and white shirts. Please note that if you are not in green/white/SJA gear, you need to be in a dress standard shirt.
Congratulations to the newly-elected Senior Class Officers: Treasurer: Manny Fliegelman; Secretary: Joel Thornton-Sherman; Vice President: Ayla Brown; and President: Una McKinnon. Let’s gooooo, 2027!

Congratulations to the following Sophomores who will serve as the Class of 2029’s Class Officers for the 2026-27 school year: Treasurer Marshall May; Secretary Charlotte Rhodes; Vice President Landon D’Auria; and President Adar Fainsilber. Thank you to all who ran!
Congratulations to SJA rider Cyrus Kidder, who finished 4th in the Eastern States Cup Enduro 16U race last weekend in Avis, New York.
Girls Golf placed 5th in their meet on Tuesday, against eight teams! Low scorers for the team were Lucia Tanaglia and Brooklynn Hibshman!

Varsity Field Hockey team controlled the play and beat Missisquoi, 5-1, yesterday afternoon! Claire Trojano scored 2 goals. Aven Thomas recorded a goal and an assist, Finley McCready and Ivan Mullins also added a goal. Ayla Brown and Brooklyn Gingue also had assists. The JV team fought triumphantly to tie, 1-1, with Montana Brewer-Nyborg scoring the only goal.

The mountain bike team raced at Northfield Mount Herman in Massachusetts on Wednesday. In the girls JV race, Effie Dunn finished second, and in the boys JV race, Ignacio Montague finished 8th and Gannon Pace 9th. The boys varsity team put three in the top ten, with Cyrus Kidder finishing 5th, Brody Dussault 6th, and Julian Maguire 8th. In the girls varsity race, Tillie Lange finished second. Congratulations to all racers!
The Varsity Volleyball team fell short to Burlington, 3-1, but the JV team beat Burlington, 2-0.
Happy Birthday today to Savannah Hussey-Koval, Skylar Jones, Jack Rachdorf, and Bijou St. Pierre!
